sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a long hall of rose stone where the makers' old water channels cross the floor in dry stone troughs at different heights, carved spouts on the walls. A tar ball rolls down a long stone groove from the far end of the hall toward a hooded bronze bowl by a door, its flames shrinking to embers, almost out; halfway along the groove a tall bronze relay brazier stands beside it, just lit, its cool ember-orange flame leaning over the groove so the ball will catch again as it passes. High on the side wall a narrow ledge and a shut keepers' door. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack stands by the brazier, a burning splash still arcing from the nozzle, dwarfed by the hall. Friezes of three dots over an upward arc. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, rose and ochre stone, ember orange, bronze, turquoise traces, deep lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
